title: Nvidia contributes rack and compute tray designs to Open Compute Project
excerpt: Nvidia announced new partnerships and contributions at the Open Compute Project Global Summit.
bodyHtml:
At the Open Compute Project Global Summit taking place on October 12, 2026, Nvidia announced new partnerships and contributions aimed at creating a common foundation for next-generation AI infrastructure. According to Nvidia, the company contributed key Nvidia Vera Rubin rack and compute tray designs to the Open Compute Project through the open Nvidia MGX architecture.

The updated MGX 1.2 specification extends the open architecture for artificial intelligence factories with rack-scale blind-mate liquid cooling, interoperable rack-scale interconnect infrastructure and a liquid-cooled 5,000A busbar designed for higher-power artificial intelligence systems. The architecture supports rack deployments up to 250kW while simplifying serviceability, deployment and infrastructure reuse.

Additionally, Nvidia and Cisco announced the Ultra-Dense Small Form Factor Pluggable standard. This is the industry’s first module for 400Gb/s-based networking fabrics. The new form factor is designed for the scale and efficiency demands of next generation AI factories, supporting higher-bandwidth fabrics while preserving the flexibility and serviceability that have made pluggable optics a mainstay of modern data centers.
topic: OCP Global Summit: Amid Ecosystem Adoption, NVIDIA Opens Vera Rubin Architecture to Help Scale AI Factories Worldwide
